text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen is a momentous race in which only the most popular and meritorious Umamusume can compete.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The crowd cheers exuberantly, eager to see an unexpectedly familiar lineup of racers compete.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Golden Generation are all here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: King Halo lets out a sigh and confidently diminishes her competitors as her "backup dancers" for today's grand event.
